title: Dinosaur holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dinosaur body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='66' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M23 68 Q10 60 8 48 Q18 54 25 56' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- tail tip highlight -->
  <path d='M8 48 Q11 52 14 54 Q12 50 10 47 Z' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='48' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='33' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='37' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='3' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1.6' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M64 40 Q68 44 72 40' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spikes on back -->
  <path d='M40 50 L44 42 L48 50 Z' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <path d='M34 56 L39 49 L43 56 Z' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <path d='M28 62 L33 55 L37 62 Z' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='80' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <rect x='49' y='80' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- arm holding heart -->
  <path d='M60 58 Q66 54 68 58' stroke='#388E3C' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M70 52 Q70 46 75 46 Q80 46 80 52 Q80 58 75 63 Q70 58 70 52 Z' fill='#FF5252'/>
  <path d='M71.5 50 Q73 47 75 48' stroke='#FF8A80' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
